title: agent.json
description: The record of an agent, in its folder beside agent.md. The author writes name and description, and may write files and packs. An agent a component ships holds only those: its agent.json names no harness, no model and no effort, and rbtv refuses a component whose shipped agent names one. In an installation, an rbtv agent's agent.json also holds harness, model and effort: rbtv agent add writes them from its --harness, --model and --effort flags when the file has none, and rbtv agent configure changes them. rbtv writes voice through rbtv agent configure, files and packs through rbtv agent add and remove, and the record of generated files. Programs read it, and the agent's own commands read it too.

name.description: The agent's name. It equals the agent folder's name and the name in agent.md.

description.description: One line that tells a caller when to choose this agent.

harness.description: The harness that runs the rbtv agent. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

model.description: The model. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

effort.description: The effort word that the model accepts. Only in an installation. Checked against cast models list.

voice.description: Optional voice, written by rbtv agent configure. Not checked.

files.description: The files chosen on their own, as full ids <module>/<component>#<name>. A short name is accepted on input when it is unique in the source catalog.

packs.description: The names of packs enabled for this agent.

schema.description: The version of this record's format.

components.description: Each component that generated files for this agent, keyed by its id. Under a component, `selected` maps each installed file to its type (`method`) and its generated `files`. A unit of type agent, installed as a harness-native sub-agent, also holds `sub_agent`: for each harness the file is written for, the `model` (cast's name for it), the `model_id` (the harness's own name for it) and the `effort`.

shared_files.description: Files shared by components through booked keys or fenced sections.

shared_claims.description: Which component owns each booked key or fenced section inside a shared file, as path::key.

guidance_basis.description: The folder instructions file the author writes: CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

guidance_excludes.description: Paths rbtv does not walk when it writes folder instructions copies.
